children: United States Commodity Index Funds Trust reported combined net income of $59,578,275 for July 2026 and monthly statements for USCI and CPER were furnished.
United States Commodity Index Fund (USCI) reported net income of $31,987,524 for July; NAV end of month $369,384,403.
USCI net asset value per share was $101.20 based on 3,650,000 shares outstanding.
United States Copper Index Fund (CPER) posted net income of $27,590,751 for July; end‑month NAV $732,117,662.
CPER activity included 1,100,000 shares added and 1,600,000 shares withdrawn during July; NAV per share $39.15 (18,700,000 shares).
Combined trust totals: total income $60,437,852, total expenses $859,577, resulting in combined net income $59,578,275 and ending NAV $1,101,502,065.
